evidence_tree.command: git archive --format=tar HEAD data docs/math-foundations.md | tar -x -C <scratch>
evidence_tree.scope_honored: Only data/ and docs/math-foundations.md from the export were read. src/, tests/, scripts/, docs/plans/, docs/receipts/, git history, the diff and the plan were never opened.

reconstruction_of_the_scenario.method: The scenario definition is not reachable from the permitted export, so the fight configuration was solved for from the two candidate leaf values themselves, using only sourced Syndra rows from data/champions.json.
reconstruction_of_the_scenario.search: Every sourced Syndra damage row (Q/W/E per rank, R per-sphere x 1..7 spheres, R Minimum, R Maximum per rank) was inverted for the ability power that makes 894.0 exact, and likewise for 614.0, then intersected. Exactly two AP values admit both numbers; one of them (AP = 38.571) requires R to change rank between the old and the new snapshot of the same scenario and is therefore rejected. The surviving solution is AP = 690.0.

solved_configuration.why_it_matches_the_scenario_name: 690 = 600 x 1.15. The '120' in 'syndra_custom_order_120' is the Splinters of Wrath option at its cap, which is exactly the threshold at which P Transcendent grants +15% ability power. The scenario name and the solved AP agree independently.
solved_configuration.ability_ranks: E rank 5 and R rank 3 (co-existing from level 16 upward), consistent with a max-level fight
solved_configuration.how_mitigation_was_pinned: docs/math-foundations.md 2.1 gives m(R) = 100/(100+R), linear in raw damage. The observed difference 894.0 - 614.0 = 280.0 equals the difference of the two rows' flat bases (480 - 200 = 280) with no scaling, so m = 1 exactly; the manual target is unmitigated (0 effective MR after penetration).

candidate_for_the_old_value.identity: R - Unleashed Power, rank 3, fired with the minimum 3 spheres
candidate_for_the_old_value.sourced_row: Magic Damage per Sphere = 160 (+ 20% AP) at rank 3; Minimum Magic Damage = 480 (+ 60% AP)
candidate_for_the_old_value.arithmetic: per sphere 160 + 0.20 x 690.0 = 298.0; 3 spheres -> 3 x 298.0 = 894.0, which reproduces the wiki's Minimum row 480 + 0.60 x 690.0 = 894.0

independent_computation.key_finding: Both numbers are arithmetically correct sourced Syndra rows at the same solved configuration, but they belong to DIFFERENT abilities. At AP = 690 the value 614.0 is uniquely E rank 5 (no R sphere count yields 614: the sphere quantum is 298, giving 298/596/894/1192/...), and 894.0 is uniquely R at 3 spheres (no E rank yields 894: the E ladder at this AP is 474/509/544/579/614). Therefore the leaf did not change by an arithmetic correction - the damage-event ledger was re-ordered (or an event was inserted/removed ahead of index 5), so slot 5 now holds a different ability.

which_ordering_is_right.default_slot_order: data/champion-audit/batch-6.json records the Syndra module's modeled slots as [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] - i.e. the default emission order ends Q, Q2, W, E, R, with R last.
which_ordering_is_right.old_ledger_is_the_default_order: With 120 splinters the W row splits into its magic and its 60-splinter true-damage part, giving six ability damage events in the default order Q, Q2, W-magic, W-true, E, R. Under that order index 5 is R = 894.0 - exactly the old value. The old snapshot is bit-for-bit what you get when the scenario's custom ordering is NOT applied and the module's default slot order is used instead.
which_ordering_is_right.new_ledger_is_a_non_default_order: The new value places E at index 5, i.e. the ledger no longer ends on R. That is only reachable when the ordering actually differs from the module default - which is precisely what a scenario named 'custom_order' is built to exercise.
which_ordering_is_right.conclusion: A scenario whose entire purpose is a custom (non-default) ability order should not reproduce the default order's ledger. The old snapshot did; the new one does not. The new value is the one consistent with the scenario's own premise, and 614.0 is an exactly sourced E rank-5 number at the scenario's AP.
which_ordering_is_right.residual_uncertainty: The scenario's explicit cast order is not visible from the permitted export, so the ordering argument rests on (a) the recorded default slot order [P, Q, Q2, W, E, R] and (b) the scenario name. Every alternative mechanism that could produce this shift - honoring a previously-ignored custom order, dropping a spurious event ahead of index 5, or inserting a legitimate missing event ahead of index 5 - points the same way. The only reading that would favour the old value is a regression that inserted a spurious event, for which nothing in the permitted evidence gives support.

sources_quoted.source: docs/math-foundations.md, Section 1.2 'Linearity of expectation for multi-hit abilities'
sources_quoted.quote: A part with h identical hits is mitigated per hit and summed: sum_h m(R)*raw = h*m(R)*raw (_mitigate_hits). This is exact because the mitigation operator x -> x*100/(100+R) is linear in raw damage for a fixed resistance.
sources_quoted.used_for: justifying that R's 3 spheres may be summed into one 894.0 event without changing the post-mitigation total
